### Key Changes
1. **Component Design**: Created [TransferCurveScope.h](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/UI/TransferCurveScope.h) and [TransferCurveScope.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/UI/TransferCurveScope.cpp) containing the `ShredBoost::TransferCurveScope` class, implementing equal-power weight morphing, lowpass ballistics for the input dot position, and neon-styled JUCE graphics.
2. **Build Configuration**: Updated [CMakeLists.txt](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/CMakeLists.txt) to compile the new UI code into both target `ShredBoost` and test runner `ShredBoostUnitTests`, and resolved a pre-existing compile error related to VST3 parameter automation replacement warnings (`JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2`).
3. **Unit Tests**: Added [TransferCurveScopeTests.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/tests/TransferCurveScopeTests.cpp) to verify default weight states, transition morph loops, telemetry bindings, and push updates. All tests pass successfully.
